E0123

loop stride must be a positive Int (D-LOOP-ADVANCE2)

What

loop stride must be a positive Int (D-LOOP-ADVANCE2)

Why

The registered sema/runtime rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0123

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0123: tests/ui/range_step_not_positive.stderr.

Error [E0123]: a range loop stride must be positive, not 0
  --> tests/ui/range_step_not_positive.jet:2:21
    |
  2 |     loop i in 0..4, 0 -> print("{i}")
    |                     ^
 Why: a zero or negative stride would never reach the end
 Fix: use a stride of 1 or more, like `loop i in 0..10, 2 { ... }`
